### <a name="spamassmilter--config"></a>`spamassmilter::config`

create a config for spamass-milter

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `spamassmilter::config` class:

* [`options`](#-spamassmilter--config--options)
* [`socket`](#-spamassmilter--config--socket)
* [`socketowner`](#-spamassmilter--config--socketowner)
* [`socketmode`](#-spamassmilter--config--socketmode)
* [`sysconfig_file`](#-spamassmilter--config--sysconfig_file)

##### <a name="-spamassmilter--config--options"></a>`options`

Data type: `Array`

An Array of start options. The Array is joined and used
for start.

Default value: `$spamassmilter::params::options`

##### <a name="-spamassmilter--config--socket"></a>`socket`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Socket to create.
Remark: on Debian, the socket is created automatically if
postfix is installed, see the $sysconfig files comment

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-spamassmilter--config--socketowner"></a>`socketowner`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

the owner of the socket to create

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-spamassmilter--config--socketmode"></a>`socketmode`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

permissions of the socket

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-spamassmilter--config--sysconfig_file"></a>`sysconfig_file`

Data type: `String`

where to write the config.

Default value: `$spamassmilter::params::sysconfig_file`
